AzureOpenAI._comment: AuthType: 'ApiKey' (default) = paste Key 1 from portal → Keys and Endpoint into ApiKey. 'Bearer' = paste an Entra ID access token (az account get-access-token --resource https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/) into ApiKey.

AzureSearch._comment: ContentField and TitleField must match your actual index schema. Use the Discover button in the app's ⚙ config panel to find the right names. Azure AI Studio indexes typically use 'chunk' and 'title'.

Rag.SystemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. When context documents are provided, use them to answer the user's question accurately.

CosmosDb._comment: PartitionKeyPath must match your container's partition key. For NEW containers created by this app, the default '/sourceBlob' works. For EXISTING containers (e.g. with '/vendorId'), set PartitionKeyPath to match and set PartitionKeyValue to any fixed string (e.g. 'rag-docs') so all documents share one partition.
